threads.Author: claude
threads.Text: [S] Judgment call: I call this duplication, but re-deriving tasks from a reviewed plan may be a feature, not waste. A generated task list is executable in a way reviewed prose is not. Disagree here and F6 becomes an argument for the handoff rather than against it.
